PostToolUse.command: file="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS"; if [ -n "$file" ] && echo "$file" | grep -q '\.py$'; then cd /Users/s.soni/Desktop/I/Projects/spy-signal-platform && .venv/bin/ruff check --fix "$file" 2>/dev/null; .venv/bin/ruff format "$file" 2>/dev/null; fi; exit 0

Stop.command: output=$(cat); reject=0; if echo "$output" | grep -qi 'pre-existing\|pre existing\|already existed\|was already'; then echo 'STOP: Do not dismiss issues as pre-existing. Fix them or explicitly flag them.' >&2; reject=1; fi; if echo "$output" | grep -qi 'out of scope\|beyond the scope\|separate issue\|follow.up task\|in a follow-up'; then echo 'STOP: Do not defer problems to follow-ups. Fix issues you find or explain why you cannot.' >&2; reject=1; fi; exit $reject
